name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
benefit: Single-window revolving credit for farmers covering: short-term crop cultivation costs, post-harvest expenses, produce marketing loans, household consumption needs, working capital for farm assets and allied activities (animal husbandry, dairy, fisheries), and investment/term loans. Short-term loans up to Rs 5 lakh at 7% per annum under the Modified Interest Subvention Scheme; timely repayment earns a 3% Prompt Repayment Incentive, making the effective rate 4%. Loans up to Rs 2 lakh are collateral-free (effective 1 January 2025). Credit limit is based on the crop's Scale of Finance x cultivated area, plus 10% for post-harvest/consumption and 20% for farm asset maintenance. Card valid 5 years with ~10% annual limit increase, includes a RuPay debit card usable at ATMs.
eligibility_rules: Farmers - individual or joint borrowers who are owner cultivators
Tenant farmers, oral lessees and sharecroppers are eligible even without owning land
Self Help Groups (SHGs) or Joint Liability Groups (JLGs) of farmers, including tenant farmers and sharecroppers
Farmers engaged in allied activities: animal husbandry, dairy, poultry and fisheries (extended in 2019)
Applicant should generally be 18 to 75 years old; applicants above 60 require a co-applicant (usually a legal heir) as co-borrower
Aadhaar submission to the bank is mandatory to avail the interest subvention benefit
exclusions: Persons not engaged in agriculture or the covered allied activities are not eligible
Interest subvention applies only to short-term loans up to Rs 5 lakh; amounts above that are charged at the bank's normal commercial rates
Loans above Rs 2 lakh require collateral/security documents (mortgage of land or immovable property; the collateral-free limit is Rs 3 lakh in tie-up arrangements)
Farmers who repay late lose the 3% Prompt Repayment Incentive and delayed payments can attract compound interest
Interest subvention is not available without Aadhaar details submitted to the bank
documents_required: Filled application form with two passport-size photographs
ID proof: Aadhaar card / Voter ID / Driving License / Passport (Aadhaar mandatory for interest subvention)
Address proof: Aadhaar card / Driving License
Proof of landholding duly certified by the revenue authorities (e.g. 7/12 extract in Maharashtra); tenant farmers/sharecroppers submit applicable agreement or declaration as per state rules
Security documents for loan limits above the collateral-free threshold, as applicable
how_to_apply: Online: visit the chosen bank's website, select Kisan Credit Card, fill and submit the application; the bank responds within 3-4 working days if eligible. Offline: apply at any bank branch or Common Service Centre (CSC). PM-Kisan beneficiaries get priority under government KCC saturation drives.
source_document: myScheme KCC page; PIB press releases on MISS/KCC limits (2025-26); RBI Master Circular - Kisan Credit Card Scheme
